{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Steel Lizal Shield Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Steel Lizal Shield Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Steel Lizal Shield Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Steel Lizal Shield Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Defense |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 35 |TotK= 35 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 15 |TotK= 15 }} |comp= {{List| * [[Lizal Shield]] * [[Reinforced Lizal Shield]] }} |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Steel Lizal Shield|Steel Lizal Shields|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}} Steel Lizal Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 35 |durability = 15 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Steel Lizal Shield}} Steel Lizal Shields are [[Lizal Shield]]s that have been reinforced with several metal shells. They belong to the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype. Though they offer an incredible defense, their weight makes it so only a skilled soldier can bear them. They are commonly wielded by [[Black Lizalfos]], [[Silver Lizalfos]], and [[Golden Lizalfos]]. After [[Enemy|Enemies]] tier up for the second time, they are also used by [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]].{{Verify}} If [[Link]] speaks to [[Selmie]] with a Steel Lizal Shield equipped, she will make note of it. She explains that their spike makes them worth major style points, and they make their riders look hard-core while [[Shield Surfing]]. Being made of metal, Steel Lizal Shields will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, they will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_009" |Life = 15 |GuardPower = 35 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 19 |RideBreakRatio = 0.5 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 35 |durability = 15 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Steel Lizal Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Steel Lizal Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Steel Lizal Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Lizal Tri-Boomerang]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Lizal Shield * Lizalfos Gear * Reinforced Lizal Shield * Shield }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Steel Lizal Shield}}
